auth.title: GitHub session expired
auth.action: Run gh auth login and keep the repo scope.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.action: Check that gh has the repo scope for notifications.

logged-out.title: gh is logged out
logged-out.action: Run gh auth login on this machine.

mark.title: Could not mark as read
mark.action: The item was restored; try again.

network.title: Offline or unreachable
network.action: Check the network and press refresh.

no-gh.title: gh CLI not found
no-gh.action: Install the GitHub CLI and sign in.

notify_new.label: Desktop toast for new notifications
notify_new.description: Show a desktop notification when a new unread item arrives. Off by default.
